info.title: MediLink HMS API
info.description: Contract for the MediLink hospital management API, generated from backend/openapi/catalog.js. MediLink AI features are decision support only and are not clinically validated for diagnosis or treatment. Authorization metadata: x-roles (role keys allowed by the route), x-owner-access (record owners who pass record-level checks), x-care-scope (doctors need a care relationship; nurses need an active encounter), x-record-access, x-patient-visibility, x-audit. All JSON responses are stripped of credential fields (password, reset tokens) by the server.

servers.description: Same origin as the deployed API

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, password reset, and own-profile operations.

tags.name: Dashboards
tags.description: Role dashboards; each is scoped to the caller.

tags.name: Patients
tags.description: Patient registration, role-projected lists, and patient detail.

tags.name: Clinical records
tags.description: Medical history, lab/radiology reports, and attachments. Staff-only writes with care/modality scope.

tags.name: Clinical notes
tags.description: AI/record-derived drafts and clinician review with explicit confirmation and versioning.

tags.name: Appointments
tags.description: Booking, scheduling state machine, cancellation, and rescheduling.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Bills, payments (no payment gateway), and insurance claims.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Access and activity audit trail (Admin only).

tags.name: AI
tags.description: Decision-support tools. Not clinically validated; outputs require human review.

post.x-audit: AiAuditEvent (metadata only: agent, source, model, degraded, success, duration; no prompt or response content)
post.x-patient-visibility: Patients never see provider, model, or fallback details in the UI; responses carry source metadata (sourceType, requiresHumanReview, limitations) and are decision support only — not a diagnosis. Emergency responses include emergencyContacts (and tel: actions in chat) chosen from location packs: patients by their profile state, staff by the hospital location (HOSPITAL_COUNTRY / HOSPITAL_STATE). The location is never sent to the AI provider. Symptom guidance may add seasonal warning signs or raise urgency for the location and month (never lower it) and never names a disease.
